{{Quote|I.N.S. ''Assessor'', calling stock light freighter. Identify yourself, please.''"<br />"''Ah, ''Assessor'', this is the freighter ''Dorion Discus''.''"<br />"''Stand by, ''Dorion Discus''. '''''Assessor''''' was an [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] patrolling the [[Thorgeld system/Legends|Thorgeld system]]. It attempted to stop the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]], but it escaped.

==Description==
As all of the customs patrol ships, the ''Assessor'' was well armed. Only one of her shots caused system error in the ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]].<ref name="RPG" />

==History==
The ''Assessor'' patrolled in the [[Thorgeld system/Legends|Thorgeld system]], when the ''Dorion Discus'' freighter caught the attention of the crew. They called the ship for customs inspection, but the ''Discus'' refused to accept it. After a warning shot, a fray began. The ''Assessor'' hit the freighter, but it managed to enter hyperspace.<ref name="RPG" />
